column2: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR  THE REPEAL OF THE DEBITS TAX
ACT, NO. 16 OF 2002

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Debits  Tax  (Repeal)
(1)  The  Debits  Tax Act,  No.  16  of  2002  is  hereby

column1: deemed to be repealed with effect from March 31, 2011.

column2: (2) The provisions of this Act shall, notwithstanding such

column1: repeal, in respect of the matters set out in subsection (3), be in
force for a period of three years from the date of the coming

column2: (3)  Notwithstanding  the  repeal  of  the  Debits  Tax Act,

column1: No. 16 of 2002 with effect from March 31, 2011:—

column2: the  debits  tax  imposed  under  section  2  of  the
repealed Act, with effect from April 1, 2011, to the
day  immediately  preceding  the  day  on  which  the
operation of the period of three years as specified in
subsection  (2)  expires,  be  collected  by  every
licensed  commercial  bank  or  specialised  bank  or
every financial institution in terms of section 5 of
the repealed Act and all sums so recovered by every
such  bank  and  financial  institution  as  debits  tax
shall be remitted to the Commissioner-General in
terms of section 6 of the repealed Act ; and
any  action,  proceeding  or  matter  filed  under  the
provisions of the Debits  Tax Act, No. 16 of 2002
prior to its repeal, shall notwithstanding such repeal,
